$comment: Eval tasks for the Devkit MCP. An agent gets ONLY this MCP (no repository, no wiki checkout) and must produce a resource that (1) passes open77_validate with zero errors against the served build, (2) passes the server's own --lint, and (3) behaves in the real game under the Open77 autonomous test loop (base/docs/agent-autonomous-testing.md). Static gates run in CI on every index publish; the in-game gate runs on the workstation (evals/run-static.mjs prints the prompts, the in-game harness is scripts/agent-play.ps1 in open77-base).

tasks.prompt: Write an Open77 resource `eval_taxi` where a player types /taxi to have a taxi vehicle spawn near them and drive them to their current map waypoint. Use only natives the MCP confirms exist on this build; the server owns the vehicle. Include the manifest with exactly the permissions required.

steps: assert a vehicle exists within 15 m within 10 s (open77_snapshot)
assert the player's vehicle is driving toward the waypoint after 20 s
ingame.proof: open77_snapshot shows the player in a vehicle whose position converges on the waypoint

tasks.prompt: Write an Open77 resource `eval_cuff` with two server commands: /cuff <playerId> freezes the target's movement and plays the cuffed animation; /escort <playerId> makes the target follow the officer. Use the role-play kit guide as reference. Refuse the commands when the target is not alive.

steps: assert the second player cannot move (open77_input forward, position unchanged)
walk the first player 10 m; assert the second player followed within 3 m
ingame.proof: positions from open77_snapshot on both clients

tasks.prompt: Write an Open77 resource `eval_shop` that opens a WebUI shop page with the F6 key listing three items with prices, and on purchase sends a net event to the server which validates the price server-side and answers with a notification. The client never decides the price.

steps: assert the server log shows the validated purchase and the client got the notification
ingame.proof: server log line + open77_screenshot with the notification

tasks.prompt: Write an Open77 gamemode `eval_arena`: players who type /arena join a routing bucket, get a fixed loadout, and the round ends when one player is left alive; the winner is announced in chat and everyone returns to the main bucket. Server-authoritative; use the deathmatch guide as reference.

steps: assert both are in the same non-default bucket
assert the chat announces the winner and both buckets return to 0

tasks.prompt:
Port this FiveM client script to Open77 as resource `eval_port`. Keep the behaviour: a key opens a menu that lists nearby vehicles and lets the player teleport into the driver seat of one. Replace every FiveM native with the Open77 equivalent the MCP gives, and list what could not be ported.

```lua
RegisterCommand('cars', function()
  local ped = PlayerPedId()
  local coords = GetEntityCoords(ped)
  for _, veh in ipairs(GetGamePool('CVehicle')) do
    if #(GetEntityCoords(veh) - coords) < 30.0 then
      print(GetDisplayNameFromVehicleModel(GetEntityModel(veh)))
    end
  end
end)
```

steps: connect one client near vehicles (spawn two)
assert the two vehicles are listed
pick one; assert the player is in its driver seat
